canonical_project: Jiangmen Municipal Intelligent Computing Center (Heshan Bluesea Data Center)
notes: Landed at Heshan Bluesea 2024-12-19, built by Guangdong Bluesea, operated by Jiangmen Mobile; 8,145 cabinets, ~500 PFLOPS by June 2026, target 2,000 PFLOPS end-2026. 21jingji (2026-08-11) calls it an international T3+ level super-large GBA data center. No MW disclosed.
